biggest_catch: The daily checklist bonus is real but small — the actual money comes from surveys and offers, which pay pennies each and disqualify you often.
catches: ySense pays per survey/offer — typical earnings are a few dollars per hour of active effort, not passive income.
Survey disqualifications are common; screening questions are unpaid.
Earnings and survey availability vary by country and demographics.
The daily bonus requires completing the full daily checklist — just logging in is not enough.

c1.evidence: ySense is a real operating platform — ysense.com loaded live with active free signup; operated by Prodege, LLC (also behind Swagbucks, InboxDollars, MyPoints); formerly ClixSense (rebranded 2019).

c2.evidence: Official homepage documents the model: 'Paid Surveys — Earn cash for taking free paid surveys', 'Cash Offers', and 'Referrals... earn up to 10% of what your referrals make.'

c3.evidence: Free to join; no upfront fee.

c4.evidence: No official fixed payout figure exists for the daily checklist bonus — the pay MECHANISM is verified: complete the daily checklist of surveys/offers, earn a bonus credit on top of per-task earnings, cash out via PayPal/gift cards. payout_quote is null.

eligibility: Free signup; available in many countries including the US; 18+ typical for PayPal payouts.

s6.note: Steps are concrete: sign up, profile, daily checklist, bonus, cashout.

steps: Create a free account at ysense.com and confirm your email.
Complete your profile surveys to unlock matched surveys.
Each day, work through the daily checklist (surveys, offers, daily poll).
Finish the full checklist to trigger the daily bonus credit.
Cash out via PayPal or gift cards once you reach the minimum threshold.
timing: Daily checklist bonus credits when the day's checklist is complete; payouts via PayPal/gift cards once the cashout minimum is reached.
